text:
Jason Robertson said no to Seattle in June: the Kraken had a trade and a long-term offer lined up, and he declined it. He then signed a one-year deal with Dallas, so he is playing through another contract year. TSN's headline on Nov. 25 captured where it stands: no comment on the reported $125 million Kraken offer, and happy with the Stars "right now". He told The Athletic the situation feels "eerily similar".

On the ice he has 26 points in 24 games and steady chance creation. The flag is on-ice luck: Dallas has scored 8.6 more goals than its chances deserved with him on the ice, which pads his total. His own shooting is right at league average, so there is no finishing bubble to pop. Evolving-Hockey had him 14th among 401 forwards in wins above replacement last season, driving play in the 98th percentile. Our numbers project about 90 points. Watch the extension talks as closely as the scoresheet.
headline: Robertson plays another contract year his way
